page.head: Tertiæ Prælectionis Summarium.
page.l: 6, &c. | Non sunt omnia piorum facta, quæ in sacri Scriptura unde recitantur, imitanda.
12, &c. | In exemplis applicandis proclive est errare.
16, &c. | Argumentum ab exemplo, contra ingeniculatio-nis ritum in sacra Cœnâ percipiendâ, exa-mini subjicitur.
25. &c. | Cujusquam hominis placitis intutum est con-scientiam subjicere.
28. | Pontificis Romani in conscientias hominum ty-rannis.
page.head: Quartæ Prælectionis Summarium.
page.notes: The heading "Quartæ Præl-ectionis Summa-rium" is split over two lines and carries no number, so no caput attribute. The ct ligature in "Prælectionis" and the long s are normalised to plain s and ct. The line "ingeniculatio-nis" is a line-end hyphen, which I read as printed but is not certain. The right-edge sliver shows cut-off marginal numbers and fragments of the neighbouring page; these were left out. No page number, running head or catchword is printed.
